title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ‘Integrated development-humanitarian programme: Climate-proofing agricultural, energy, and food security practices in Luuq, Belet Xawa, Dollow, Garbaharey, and El Wak counties, Gedo region’ programme, implemented by Trócaire, aims to contribute to Outcome 2.1: Poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, have sustainable lives including diverse food sources and economic well-being. The activities and objective include, enabling access to land, training on agro-ecological farming practices, production of energy saving stoves and participatory water management & irrigation systems so participants can adopt agro-ecological approaches at household and community levels. Programmes are in partnership with, Somali Humanitarian Relief Action and Centre for Research and Integrated Development.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 2.1Poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, have sustainable lives including diverse food sources and economic well-being. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The principal focus of this outcome is:- Increase the resilience of poor and marginalised rural communities by mitigating and adapting to the impacts of climate change and environmental degradation.- Promote sustainable, resilient approaches to agriculture i.e. the adoption of agroecological practicesThis work will contribute to the availability of diverse food sources in target communities, and in turn, to improved nutrition outcomes.
